segments.name: CDMO
products: formulated and filled syringes and vials
segments.description: Contract development and manufacturing of complex sterile injectable drug and device products, including HA, for biopharmaceutical customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's chief operating decision maker, as defined by U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("U.S. GAAP"), manages CDMO and HA manufacturing operations on the basis of a single integrated segment.

revenueModel.text: Biopharmaceutical and biotechnology customers pay for development services and for cGMP manufacturing and aseptic filling of their sterile injectable products.
revenueModel.evidence: We manufacture HA in bulk form as well as for use in formulated and filled syringes and vials for our customers' injectable products used in treating a broad spectrum of medical conditions and procedures, including ophthalmic and orthopedic applications.

changes.text: In 2023 Lifecore divested its food businesses and began operating as a stand-alone integrated CDMO.
changes.evidence: In May 2023, Lifecore completed the divestiture of these food businesses, and beginning with fiscal year 2024, we operate as a stand-alone integrated CDMO.
